mapper.select: SELECT r.RESOURCE_ID, r.EOS_STATUS_CD, l.EOS_YMD, l.EOL_YMD FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE r JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT_LFC l ON l.VERSION_ID = r.VERSION_ID AND l.EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL WHERE r.DISPOSE_YN = 'N' AND r.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT POLICY_VAL FROM TB_EOS_POLICY WHERE POLICY_TYPE_CD = #{policyTypeCd} AND POLICY_KEY = #{policyKey} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT EXC_REQ_ID, RESOURCE_ID, END_YMD, STATUS_CD FROM TB_EOS_EXC_REQ WHERE STATUS_CD IN ('APPROVED', 'CONDITIONAL') AND END_YMD < #{asOfYmd}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_EOS_ACTION_PLAN WHERE STATUS_CD NOT IN ('DONE', 'EXC_MGMT') AND PLAN_END_YMD < #{asOfYmd}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_EOS_EXC_REQ e WHERE e.STATUS_CD IN ('APPROVED', 'CONDITIONAL') AND e.MONTHLY_CHECK_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_EOS_MONTHLY_CHK m WHERE m.EXC_REQ_ID = e.EXC_REQ_ID AND m.CHECK_YM = #{checkYm} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EOS_BATCH_RUN SET END_DTM = #{endDtm}, PROCESS_CNT = #{processCnt}, SUCCESS_CNT = #{successCnt}, FAIL_CNT = #{failCnt}, STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}, MSG_TXT = #{msgTxt} WHERE RUN_ID = #{runId}
